verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a homepage marketing line claiming "token exchange, and agent delegation" for AI agents. The MCP plugin and Device Authorization grant show Better Auth can issue user-consented OAuth tokens to agents for the app's own resources, but nothing documents brokering or vaulting short-lived tokens for third-party APIs. missing for 10: documented token-vault storage and retrieval of third-party provider tokens, documented token-exchange flow for agents calling external APIs, short-lived token and consent semantics for delegated third-party calls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
